title: DFEClkFwd
text: 接收机 AMI 模型中的带时钟转发的 DFE，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Mode} 指定DFE 工作模式；{Initial tap weights (V)} 指定初始 DFE 抽头权重、{Adaptive gain} 控制 DFE 抽头权重更新速率 9.6e-5、{Adaptive step size (V)} 指定 DFE 自适应步进分辨率 1e-06、{Minimum DFE tap value (V)} 指定自适应抽头的最小值、{Maximum DFE tap value (V)} 指定自适应抽头的最大值、{2x tap weights} 指定将 DFE 抽头权重乘以二、{Phase offset (symbol time)} 指定手动时钟相位偏移、{Reference offset (ppm)} 指定参考时钟偏移损伤、{Early/late count threshold} 指定触发相位更新的早/晚 CDR 计数阈值、{Step (symbol time)} 指定时钟相位分辨率、{Sensitivity (V)} 指定采样锁存器亚稳态电压，按实例取值。

ports.name: WaveIn
ports.summary: 输入基带信号 scalar | vector

ports.name: WaveOut
ports.summary: 估计的信道输出 scalar | vector

params.name: Mode
params.values: DFE 工作模式 Fixed (default) | Off | Adapt

params.name: Initial tap weights (V)
params.values: 初始 DFE 抽头权重 [0 0 0 0] (default) | row vector

params.name: Adaptive gain
params.values: 控制 DFE 抽头权重更新速率 9.6e-5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Adaptive step size (V)
params.values: DFE 自适应步进分辨率 1e-06 (default) | nonnegative real scalar | nonnegative real-valued row vector

params.name: Minimum DFE tap value (V)
params.values: 自适应抽头的最小值 -1 (default) | real scalar | real-valued row vector

params.name: Maximum DFE tap value (V)
params.values: 自适应抽头的最大值 1 (default) | nonnegative real scalar | nonnegative real-valued row vector

params.name: 2x tap weights
params.values: 将 DFE 抽头权重乘以二 on (default) | off

params.name: Phase offset (symbol time)
params.values: 手动时钟相位偏移 0 (default) | real scalar in the range [−0.5, 0.5]

params.name: Reference offset (ppm)
params.values: 参考时钟偏移损伤 0 (default) | real scalar in the range [−300, 300]

params.name: Early/late count threshold
params.values: 触发相位更新的早/晚 CDR 计数阈值 5 (default) | positive real integer ≥5

params.name: Step (symbol time)
params.values: 时钟相位分辨率 0.005 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Sensitivity (V)
params.values: 采样锁存器亚稳态电压 0 (default) | real scalar
